questions.stem: Look! The boys ____ (play) basketball over there.

options.distractor: Look! 说明正在发生，要用进行时
the boys 是复数，且缺 be 动词

questions.explanation: Look! 提示眼前正在发生，用 are playing。

questions.stem: — What is she doing? — She ____ (read) a book.

options.distractor: 问句已经用了进行时，答语要一致
be 动词后要接 -ing 形式

questions.explanation: 问的是“正在做什么”，答语也用现在进行时 is reading。

questions.stem: Listen! The birds ____ (sing) in the tree.

options.distractor: the birds 是复数，且缺 be 动词

questions.explanation: Listen! 提示正在听到的声音，用 are singing。

questions.stem: Don't make any noise. The baby ____ (sleep).
questions.explanation: 语境说明宝宝此刻正在睡觉，用 is sleeping。

options.text: He is doing his homework now.
They are playing football on the playground.
Listen! Someone is crying in the next room.

questions.explanation: 有 Look! 和 now，应改为 Look! It is raining now。

questions.stem: — Where are the children? — They ____ (run) on the playground.

options.distractor: 问的是此刻的位置和动作
they 是复数，且缺 be 动词

questions.explanation: 问孩子们现在在哪、在干什么，答语用现在进行时 are running。
